# Parley v0.1.31

A fix release. v0.1.30 could not start a Codex host pane at all: the permission
preflight timed out after 20 seconds and refused the launch. Update if you are
on v0.1.30.

## Codex host panes start again

Parley spawned every command without resetting the signal state the child
inherits. `posix_spawn` hands the child the calling thread's blocked signal
mask unless it is told otherwise, and Parley's own threads run with signals
blocked.

A tool that inherits a blocked `SIGCHLD` is never told when its own child
processes exit. It waits forever, producing nothing, and only a kill ends it.
That is what stalled the Codex preflight: the probe started, parked every
thread and burned the whole 20-second budget without emitting a byte.

Parley now resets every signal disposition to default and clears the mask for
each command it spawns. This was never specific to Codex. Any spawned tool that
waits on child processes could stall the same way, including the reviewed
command runs, which had the identical gap.

## Command results are no longer silently reported as clean

When the wait on a spawned command failed — for instance because the child was
reaped elsewhere in the application — Parley reported exit status 0. A command
it never saw finish read as a successful one.

An unobserved wait is now its own outcome and can never be mistaken for
success. It reports status 125 and says on the command's error output that the
result is unknown.

## A preflight message that names what happened

The Codex preflight failure previously blamed legacy `sandbox_mode` and
`sandbox_workspace_write` settings on every failure, including a timeout, even
though the configuration check immediately before it had already accepted those
same settings. It sent you looking for a problem that was not there.

The message now describes what was actually observed, carries the wait
diagnostic that identifies where the time went, and explains each failure the
probe itself can report.

## Compatibility

Agent protocol is unchanged at 32. Panes already running v0.1.30 do not need a
restart for the protocol, but they must be restarted on this build to pick up
the spawn fix.

Validated: 329 native checks, 41 Node tests, public scan and build, with new
regression checks covering the inherited signal mask, the unobserved wait and
the preflight message. Each was confirmed to fail when its fix is removed. A
Codex host pane launch was confirmed working in a development build.

Unnotarized test beta: ad-hoc signed without the hardened runtime, not
notarized, no automatic updates. Install only from the expected GitLab
release after checking SHA256SUMS.
